name: A refused delete keeps the resident card
title: SC-02-03-04 A refused delete keeps the resident card
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given a resident with ledger history
When the manager deletes the resident and confirms
Then the delete is refused and the resident card stays
